card.what: Inflatable cylindrical racing mark, 0.90 m across and 1.50 m tall overall: faded orange PVC tube, two welded vertical seams, domed welded end caps, webbing lifting handle and valve on top, webbing loop and stainless ring for the anchor line underneath
card.boats: race course: windward and leeward marks (TrafficManager::StartRace)
card.distance: rounded at 2 to 5 m; seen from 300 m up the beat
card.before: Engine BasicShapes cylinder scaled 1.6 x 1.6 x 2.2 m in BasicShapeMaterial orange, centre 0.8 m above the water

references.url: Lalizas regatta marker buoy (1.5 m x 900 mm, 4 kg); Osculati 40709 cylindrical racing buoy (90 cm across, 150 cm tall); Crewsaver 3810 cylindrical buoys (4 ft: 1.22 x 0.61 m; 5 ft: 1.52 x 0.76 m); nautimarket 100 x 150 cm giant regatta buoy
references.note: numbers only; no photo could be fetched from this container (Wikimedia's upload host is blocked), so the blind review judged against the reviewers' own knowledge of the objects

features.text: Inflated tube bowing out slightly at mid height, rounded shoulders, domed end caps
Two welded vertical seams and a welded flange round each cap
Webbing lifting handle on a welded patch on top
Inflation valve on the top cap
Webbing loop and stainless ring underneath for the anchor line
Scummed band at the waterline (slot MarkScum)

budget.note: hero is a Nanite part; build_kit makes the light copy at a quarter of the triangles
